name: GET /api/project-deletions/:deletionId/certificate - the deletion certificate as PDF
description: Any member (projects:read). Once the deletion has completed: application/pdf attachment naming the firm, project, client and device, who asked and when, when rows and stored copies were removed, the 30-day deadline, the records removed per category and what is kept (audit ids, the deletion record, backups until they expire), with the SHA-256 fingerprint of its canonical record (also in the X-Certificate-SHA256 header). Reissuing gives the same bytes. 409 DELETION_IN_PROGRESS before completion. Audited (deletion_certificate.downloaded). Covers: a consultant can delete all of a project's data within 30 days and get a deletion certificate.

errorCases.when: no deletion with this id in the firm

errorCases.message: The deletion is still in progress; the certificate is issued when it completes
errorCases.when: stored copies are still being removed
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Stored copies are removed straight after the request, so the in-progress window is only observable when object storage fails or during a race. Verified by hand with storage stopped.
